name: Pottery
description: Pottery word search puzzles gather clay-and-kiln English for adults and seniors — wheel, glaze, bisque, slip, mug and quiet studio words — without pottery brands or gallery names. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays hands-on and domestic: coil, pinch, throw, sponge, shelf and form vocabulary many studio visitors already recognize. This hub pairs well with Painting, Woodworking and Knitting when you want a longer craft afternoon. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a centering pull.
